rev6.release_notes: Settings: Install / Update Add-in. Settings > Key shows checked and (admin mode) while a key is in. Add-in Export tab: Export Model to G-SEND Drawing. Check reports what the rules find, not only what the model noticed.

cadcam.release_notes: Lathe Quick Setup: CAM with no model opens the lathe window - the bar out of the jaws or the whole bar, steps by length or Z with an edge break each, and the part plus OP1 (face, rough, finish, part off) made together; one click switches a mill setup to it. Copy and paste: Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V on sketch geometry and on bodies; a pasted copy follows the cursor, a typed distance places it, a pasted line moves only square across itself (Alt any way). Sketch: a click selects in blue; hover lines thinner; the H / V / C marks hidden unless Constraints: All is on; geometry on an origin axis stays on it; redundant constraints no longer turn the sketch red; Fix on an end at the origin fixes that end; no banner over the view; Save while in a sketch saves it. Export Model to G-SEND Drawing: a STEP opens straight into its drawing. Drawings: print follows the sheet, near flat snaps to Direct View, wheel zoom as in the model, title block text centred. Save Setting on the Setup window's Machine and Milling / Turning rows and on Tool rows. View cube: type an angle after a roll. Thinner Quick dimension lines.
